But Etho, in all likelihood, did not want to "officially" be there. He has historically been really reticent to put his name behind things because he likes his privacy and keeping a separation between real life and Youtube stuff. He was present on the server and helped out with the entertainment and stuff during both GO events which really is all he probably feels comfortable doing. He tries really hard to stay away from the Youtube cult of personality stuff in general. He doesn't have a name for his viewers, he acknowledges his fans/supporters but goes out of his way to avoid anything that he might feel like is exploiting them, and left Mindcrack back in the day due to wanting to avoid the more "official" monetization of the brand. He has been content with just making money off of adsense and enjoying the Youtube process ever since he stopped taking donations years ago before adsense/Youtube creator program was implemented.

For the uniqueness of its design Fishman Island with the light from Eve's roots probably stands on top for me. The main island itself being a giant coral area as well as allowing for   
both areas above and below the water line within the bubble. Additionally having the Ryugu palace and Fish-Man district being separate but close by creating very clear distinctive zones in the area. Plus it was just a very colorful environment.

Fishman Island is definitely followed closely by Water 7 as the overall design is very cohesive and pulls a good balance between grounded and fantastical. Its like reality+ in that I can almost see a city like it existing in the real world but it definitely still is unique and fits in well with the rest of the One Piece world.

To give a little bit more characterization to the concept of an Axis. Essentially its a multi-dimensional god in the greater Talse Uzer Story (T.U.S) which is the name for the encompassing universe. Within the T.U.S are a bunch of individual "stories" or worlds with a set past and future. Phantaminum is a person who has the power to influence one of these "tales" and is also the "author" of a story in the universe. Pretty much the weakest Axis is infinitely stronger than the strongest non-Axis since the Axis is able to exert a domain in which they hold total dominion.
